about: American football pants (afootball-pants-textured.glb, RUGBYV 2026-11-23): coloured from the same garment split into parts by Tripo (afootball-pants-parts.glb) by viewer/tripo-glbparts.mjs: the waistband with its belt (tripo_part_16) the Waistband part, one smooth line at its foot; the two leg cuffs (tripo_part_3, tripo_part_6) the Cuffs part (listed as `sleeves`: one piece each with a smooth border; pastBody 1: the sleeves' 'past the body's side' rule off); body (tripo_part_71, its pads in its own shape) and the small label bits the print. Inside: the cloth's own colour in shade.
